name: where-my-hug
description: Where my hug at? Tells your agent which parts of an ML need Hugging Face already covers, which to fine-tune, which to train, and which aren't a model at all, with every model and dataset checked live.

hf_token.title: Hugging Face token (optional)
hf_token.description: Only needed to include private or gated repos your account can see. Sent only to huggingface.co, never written to a report.

roboflow_api_key.title: Roboflow API key (optional)
roboflow_api_key.description: Adds Roboflow Universe to the search; Kaggle, Zenodo and ModelScope need no key. Free at roboflow.com, under Settings, API Keys. Sent only to api.roboflow.com, never written to a report.
